entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: A Song of degrees. In my trouble I cried to the LORD, and He heard me.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What shall be given to you? Or what shall be done to you, O false tongue?

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of broom.

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: Woe is me, that I live in Mesech; I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul has long dwelt with a hater of peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I [am] for peace; but when I speak, they [are] for war.
